title: Supersession
description: Bytes are immutable; standing is not. A release found to be wrong is marked, never rewritten — deleting or editing it would destroy the audit trail that justifies the finding (ADR-0024).

superseding.description: The replacement, or null for outright withdrawal with nothing to replace it.

severity.description: CORRECTION: wrong but recoverable. RETRACTION: scientifically invalid — a retraction anywhere in a claim's provenance DAG fails the build. DEPRECATION: superseded, not wrong.
